title: UBC Main Mall off-inventory pilot
method: CHM local maxima plus marker-controlled watershed; greedy nearest inventory match; unmatched crowns filtered by height, crown, distance, and confidence.

evidence.uncertainty: Unmatched detected crowns include real off-inventory trees, missed inventory records, and over-segmentation; confidence is a screening score, not a field fact.
evidence.source: CHM local maxima + marker-controlled watershed, matched to the official inventory
